ld.meaning: lambda_cp -- the leptoquark-quark-lepton Yukawa coupling strength
ld.code:
lambda_cp = 0.3
if "ld" in JOlist: lambda_cp = eval( JOlist[ JOlist.index("ld")+1 ].replace('p','.') )

beta.meaning: branching fraction of LQ decays to a CHARGED lepton + quark (vs neutrino + quark)
beta.code:
beta = 0.5
if "beta" in JOlist: beta = eval( JOlist[ JOlist.index("beta")+1 ].replace('p','.') )
beta.comment_quoted: couplings are calculated as lambda * sqrt(beta) and lambda * sqrt(1 - beta) for decays in charged and uncharged leptons, respectively
beta.example: beta_0p5 -> 50% of LQ decays go to charged lepton + quark, 50% to neutrino + quark, by coupling construction

hnd.meaning: fraction of the charged-lepton coupling that is LEFT-handed
hnd.code:
hnd = 1.0
if "hnd" in JOlist: hnd = eval( JOlist[ JOlist.index("hnd")+1 ].replace('p','.') )
hnd.comment_quoted: hnd is the fraction of charged leptons that are left-handed, i.e. applied as sqrt(hdn) for left- and sqrt(1 - hnd) for right-handed leptons

M<mass>.meaning: leptoquark mass in GeV, extracted from the job-option filename

LQu / LQd.meaning: up-type (PDG ID 43, charge +2/3) vs down-type (PDG ID 42, charge -1/3) scalar leptoquark
LQu / LQd.model: import model LQmix_NLO -- a SCALAR leptoquark UFO model (matches the 'process: scalar leptoquark pair production' field independently reported by atlasopenmagic's own metadata)
